title: A done refused for invalid input still moves the session's focus to the named item
outcome: A done refused for invalid input still moves the session's focus to the named item
acceptance: Either a done (and any other word) refused for invalid input before any mutation leaves the session's focus unchanged, with a test, or the docs state that naming an item moves the focus even when the word is refused, and the refusal says so

completion.summary: Words now refuse malformed request input before moving focus or writing an attempt, on agent words and core JSON. Stored-state refusals stay with storage and are documented in the CLI and MCP guide. Landed as 411f8a8 after review round 16 and full gate test-1b01ec78.
